calendar.$description: A bare month grid — the one calendar every date component is built on. No trigger, no surface: DatePicker puts it in a popover, DateRangePicker puts two of it in a popover with Reset / Apply, and a page can drop it straight into a Card. Header = paging arrows + month and year selects (a far-off date is two picks, not a dozen arrow clicks). Modes: `single` (one selected day) and `range` (filled start and end + a flush band between). `months: 2` lays two consecutive months side by side, paging arrows on the outer edges only. `min` / `max` disable the days outside the allowed window. Split out on 2026-10-21 from DatePicker and DateRangePicker, which each carried their own copy of the grid and two different headers.

gap.$description: Minimum space around the selects; the header is space-between, so on a 252px month the arrows actually sit ~7px off them.

navSize.$description: 32px paging arrow. With two months, prev sits on the left month's outer edge and next on the right month's; the inner sides keep an empty 32px spacer so the selects stay centred over their grid.

navDisabledIcon.$description: An arrow that would page entirely past min / max.

select.$description: Month + year <select> pair — a compact 32px control in the field family (white, not surface.dim, because it usually sits inside a white panel).

paddingRight.$description: Room for the chevron (4px inset + 16px icon + 4px air). Tight on purpose: 'September' + the year + both arrows have to fit across one 252px month.

value.$description: 12px, same as the day numbers — at 14px 'September' + the year no longer fit between the two arrows over a 252px month.

size.$description: 36px square day cell — 7 of them make the 252px month width.

rowGap.$description: Vertical gap between weeks; columns sit flush (0 gap) so a range reads as one continuous band. 4px (not 2px) so a month is on the 4px grid at any number of weeks — 28px weekdays + 36px weeks + 4px gaps.

todayBorder.$description: Today gets a hairline ring — a quiet 'you are here', distinct from the filled selection.

selectedBg.$description: The selected day (single) and the start / end days (range) fill solid.

rangeBg.$description: Days between start and end get a light primary wash, edge to edge.

outsideColor.$description: Days spilling in from the prev/next month — shown for the grid's shape, not pickable.

disabledColor.$description: Days before min / after max — visible, not pickable.

stackedGap.$description: Space between the months once they stack (< 560px).
